note: Block: 4 frames to raise the guard, then the last frame is held (the fight shakes it in blockstun). A boxer's high shell: both forearms come up vertical in front of the face and chest, the big gauntlets side by side as a wall, the pauldrons rolled forward over the shoulders and the head ducked behind the fists; the body sinks onto bent knees and leans into it. Feet at the guard's places.
